items.title: 20.1.2 Benzene ki atomic orbital banawat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the atomic orbital structure of benzene (PDF 61-62).

blocks.text: Benzene ka hexagonal dhaancha hybridisation se samjhaya jata hai. Har carbon sp2 hybridised hai: is ke teen sp2 orbitals mein se do parosi carbons ke saath aur aik hydrogen atom ke saath sigma bonds banate hain. Sab sp2 orbitals aik plane mein hain, is liye is sigma dhaanche ke sab carbon aur hydrogen atoms aik hi plane mein, 120 darje par hain.

Har carbon ke paas aik unhybridised 2p orbital bhi hai, jo sigma dhaanche ke amudi hai. Chhe p orbitals mutawazi hain aur dono parosiyon ke saath pehlu ba pehlu milte hain, jis se ring ke plane ke oopar aur neeche pi electrons ka badal banta hai; molecule conjugated hai. Chhe pi electrons chhe ke chhe carbons mein barabar bante hue hain: yeh delocalised hain. Natija yeh ke chhe C-C bonds ki lambai barabar, 139 pm, hai, aur benzene ko andar daire wale hexagon se dikhaya jata hai, daira delocalised pi electrons ki nishani hai.

blocks.alt: Teen panel. (a) Carbon atoms ka hamwar hexagon, har aik hydrogen se jura, nishan C-C sp2-sp2 sigma aur C-H sp2-s sigma, sab 120 darje par. (b) Ring pehlu se, har carbon par khara p orbital, do lobes. (c) Pi electron density ke do halqe, aik carbons ke halqe ke oopar aur aik neeche.
blocks.caption: Benzene ka sigma dhaancha, p orbitals aur delocalised pi nizam (kitab ke doosre Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sigma bonds chhe carbons aur chhe hydrogens ko hamwar halqe mein thaame rakhte hain. Is halqe ke oopar aur neeche har carbon ka p orbital hai; ring hamwar hone se har p orbital dono parosiyon ke saath barabar milta hai. Natija plane ke oopar pi electron density ka musalsal halqa aur aik neeche hai.

blocks.caption: Carbon-carbon bonds ki lambaiyan (kitab ka Table 20.1)

blocks.prompt: Benzene ki delocalisation (resonance) energy taqreeban 152 kJ/mol hai. Is ka kya matlab hai, aur yeh benzene ki reactivity par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Benzene teen alag double bonds wale halqe se 152 kJ/mol zyada mustahkam hai. Jo reaction delocalised nizam tor de, jaise addition, yeh tawanai kho dega, is liye benzene alkenes se kam reactive hai aur substitution pasand karta hai, jo ring bachata hai.

blocks.prompt: X-ray mutale dikhate hain ke benzene hamwar hai. Agar hamwar na hota to reactivity mein kya farq hota?
blocks.explanation: p orbitals sab aapas mein nahi mil sakte, is liye pi electrons delocalised na hote. Benzene alag double bonds wale alkene ki tarah rawaiya rakhta aur aasani se addition reactions karta.

blocks.prompt: Benzene ring ke sab bonds ki lambai barabar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhe pi electrons chhe carbons par barabar phaile hain, is liye har C-C bond aik jaisa hai, single aur double bond ke darmiyan (139 pm).

blocks.prompt: Atomic orbital tasawwur benzene mein pi electrons ki delocalisation kaise samjhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Har sp2 carbon ke paas hamwar ring ke amudi aik p orbital hai; chhe mutawazi p orbitals poore halqe mein pehlu ba pehlu milte hain, is liye un ke electrons teen alag pi bonds ki bajaye ring ke oopar aur neeche aik musalsal badal banate hain.

items: Har C sp2: aik plane mein 120 darje par teen sigma bonds.
Chhe p orbitals pehlu ba pehlu: ring ke oopar neeche delocalised pi badal.
Sab C-C bonds 139 pm; nishan: daire wala hexagon.
